caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental object composed primarily of braided or twisted strands. The main strand is colored in a deep purple hue, forming a looped and intertwined shape at the top. Attached to one end of the purple strand is a section wrapped in a golden-yellow crisscross pattern, ending in a small purple segment from which a golden chain with a bell hangs. From the other end of the purple strand, several strings (colored with alternating dark and light shades) extend and are each attached to large, fluffy pompoms. These pompoms are predominantly divided into two colored segments: pale green and a pinkish-coral. The entire object is displayed against a plain, light beige background.
title: Lighter (Mecha) for Flint
